node.title: Re^3: Unexpected interaction between decode_entities() and lc()
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
First, I would strongly recommend against using any of the functions from the [doc://utf8] module, since these are really only meant for use if one knows the inner workings of how Perl handles Unicode and non-Unicode strings. Second, it seems [doc://binmode]ing STDIN is not enough - instead, try the [http://perldoc.perl.org/open.html|open] pragma with the :std option since that also sets the default [doc://open] modes and works on files passed on the command line as well . The following works for me, both for a UTF-8 file piped into perl and a file listed on the command line:

use warnings; use strict; use open qw/:std :utf8/; use HTML::Entities; while(<>) { chomp; print lc(decode_entities($_)), "\n"; }

Update: Added a missing "not", oops :-)
